scope: Source audit of normalized/candidate article and 10 linked questions against raw PDF only; no Supabase access used.
decision: PARK because the cluster cannot be fully source-verified from the specified raw PDF export and candidate.md is absent in the target article folder.

blockers.finding: candidate.md is absent in the target article folder, so the required candidate_sha256 matching candidate.md cannot be recorded. The folder contains normalized.md/original.md but no candidate.md.

article-metadata.json and sources.json report source_count/source_count = 0 and sources: [], so the exported article cluster has no existing citation/source mapping to anchor article statements to the raw PDF.

The specified raw PDF appears to be slide/image-based. PyPDF extraction from raw PDF yielded only bullets/empty text for most pages; OCR attempt on rendered raw pages produced blank text. The available OCR-conversion PDF provides only partial headings and one scope slide, insufficient to verify all article claims and 10 linked questions.

normalized.md contains many detailed claims not verified in the raw PDF text available during audit, including RA 9266/Supplemental IRR framing, 2010 replacement of 1979 UAP Doc. 204-A, CSG hiring/answerability, six named compensation methods, MDPE formula/multiplier, limitations of authority details, inspector qualifications, and detailed SPP 202 vs 204-A comparisons.
